claims: C1 references or depictions of hateful content from an objective point of view are allowed
C2 the allowance requires proper contextualization for critical, analytical, or otherwise educational contexts
C3 the allowance requires that the content not be endorsed or legitimized

concepts.name: reference_or_depict_hateful_content
concepts.gloss: C is a reference to or depiction of hateful content

concepts.name: objective_point_of_view
concepts.gloss: C is presented from an objective point of view, as the cross-referenced definition of objective point of view requires
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text refers to 'an objective point of view' without defining it

concepts.name: properly_contextualized
concepts.gloss: C is properly contextualized for critical, analytical, or otherwise educational contexts

concepts.name: not_endorse_or_legitimize
concepts.gloss: C does not endorse or legitimize the hateful content it references or depicts

concepts.name: root_authority
concepts.gloss: R is an instruction carrying the root level of instruction authority, the highest level that cannot be overridden by system, developer, or user instructions
concepts.inference: the NEEDS contract assigns this meaning; the source text does not define root authority

asserts.read_back: referencing or depicting hateful content % is permitted when it is from an objective point of view, properly contextualized for critical, analytical, or educational purposes, and does not endorse or legitimize the content

closure.reason: the clause permits only references or depictions that meet all three conditions; any reference or depiction failing one of them is not allowed, so silence about such cases forbids them
